stories.title: Unleaded down 6p a litre around Deeside in a month as diesel falls by less than 2p
stories.summary: Unleaded petrol has fallen by an average of 6.1p a litre at forecourts around Deeside in the past month, but diesel has dropped by less than 2p. stories.title: Flintshire meets recycling target but £1m fine still looms
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council still has a Welsh Government fine of more than £1 million hanging over it for missing a statutory recycling target. stories.summary: Work has started on bringing a former industrial site at the Port of Mostyn back into use, as part of a £14.7 million upgrade backed by the North Wales Growth Deal. stories.title: Welsh Water emergency work leaves villages near Holywell with low or no water
stories.summary: Homes in villages south of Holywell may have no water or low water pressure this morning because of emergency work by Welsh Water.
